Within the analytical framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this subsection treats the structural combination of the triad concerning visible and reactive phenomena (*sanidassanattika*) together with the Abhidhamma dyads beginning with grasping or clinging (*upādānadukādi*) [SuttaCentral].
